seoDescription: Learn about PyExplorer: a free game made in Brazil to teach Python to kids.
heroSubtitle: Our mission is to democratize programming education for kids around the world 🌍
story1: PyExplorer was born from a simple dream: to make learning programming as fun as playing video games. We believe code is the superpower of the 21st century, and every kid should have the chance to unlock it.
story2: Many tech courses are expensive, complex or only in English. PyExplorer was created to change that. We are 100% free and focused on the student experience.

values.freeDesc: Quality education should have no price barrier. PyExplorer is and always will be free.
values.madeInBrazilDesc: Content crafted with care, originally created in Portuguese and now available in multiple languages.
values.safeDesc: We don't sell data. We don't show intrusive ads. A safe environment to learn.
values.funDesc: No boring classes. Here you learn by solving challenges and earning rewards.

tech1: PyExplorer uses an amazing technology called WebAssembly (Pyodide). This means Python code runs directly in your browser, without installing anything!
tech2: Just access the site, type your code and see the result instantly. Works on computers, tablets and even phones.
supportDesc: Your support helps us keep the servers running and create new free content.
ctaDesc: Thousands of kids have already written their first line of code with us.
